cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I explain the burnt kitchen pan, we'll establish why you jammed the office printer. Facts first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It jammed. What were you cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'It jammed' is not an account of your actions. What did you put in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ordinary paper and sticky labels are not interchangeable. Read the warning on the packet before we move to my pan.

reason: Name a completed burnt-pan problem instead of ongoing unexplained smoke, and make precise professional questioning the means of obtaining B fuller confession first.
